newsitem.title: USA: NGC closes on sale of plant for $458 mln.
newsitem.headline: NGC closes on sale of plant for $458 mln.

text.p: NGC Corp said it has closed, with its partners in Tiger Bay LP, on the sale of a 212-megawatt gas-fired cogeneration plant to Florida Progress Corp for $458 million.
NGC said it received $146.7 million for its share of the proceeds.
The sale of Tiger Bay's assets to Florida Power was announced prior to NGC's acquisition of Destec Energy Inc.
NGC said the success of this sale, plus the previously announced sale of lignite reserves and other assets, will reduce its cost basis in the Destec assets to about $300 million.
As a result, it said its return expectations on Destec have improved significantly.
